verdict.rationale: gstack ships autonomous multi-step workflows within an agent session. /autoplan chains the CEO, design, eng and DX reviews with auto-decisions, /qa iteratively fixes and commits bugs, and /ship runs the full merge-test-PR pipeline. A persistent headless Chromium daemon and optional auto-upgrade also run without user prompting. However, these are skills a user invokes interactively, not user-configured automations that run in the background on a schedule or trigger. Missing for 10: scheduled or event-triggered background automations, a way to define and manage unattended recurring jobs, independent corroboration of unattended operation.
